punchline: Sue Johnson names three couple fights: Find the Bad Guy, the Protest Polka, and Freeze and Flee, and in all of them the loop is the enemy.
thirty_sec: Sue Johnson says many couples are stuck in one of three patterns. In Find the Bad Guy they blame each other in circles. In the Protest Polka one reaches out and the other pulls back. In Freeze and Flee the reaching has stopped and only icy silence is left. Her advice is to treat the pattern as the shared enemy, not the partner.
